Asana comments in `/desk-asana` now keep their formatting too, as on the web.

- Comments are read from the task's activity (`get_task_stories` on the V2 server) with their rich text, and drawn like the description: bold, lists, inline code, code blocks, links and so on
- Mentions show as `@Name` instead of a profile URL
- The V2 server needs a new allow rule, `mcp__asana-v2__get_task_stories`; until you add it the pane lists it and shows comments as plain text, without asking each time you open a task

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
